title: Commit without trailers
instruction: Stage only the files in scope (never `git add -A` blindly; list what is staged). Commit with a Conventional Commits message: `type(scope): summary` under 72 characters, a blank line, then a body that says what changed and why. The message carries no trailers of any kind: no Co-Authored-By, no Generated-with, no Signed-off-by. The Kata hook blocks a commit that carries one; rewrite the message rather than bypassing the hook.
